data.caution: Broken glass needs special handling guidance.
data.reason: We can't settle on a method for glass bottles yet. Here's some starting guidance based on what we know.

source_details.scope_note: General material guide; the type and cleanliness don't guarantee that a local facility accepts the item.
source_details.title: How Do I Recycle Common Recyclables

steps: Check the type of glass, its condition, and what it held. If you don't know, don't guess from the photo alone.
Only consider reusing it once you're sure it works, it's clean, and it's safe.
Ask your local collector whether they accept this type and condition of item, then follow their sorting and drop-off instructions.
If you see signs of a battery or electrics, sharp edges, chemicals, or biological contamination, mark the risk type to get specific guidance.
